value.title: Prix Renaudot
value.snippet: The Prix Théophraste-Renaudot or Prix Renaudot (French pronunciation: [pʁi teɔfʁast ʁənodo]) is a French literary award. The prize was created in 1926

value.title: Charles Braibant
